resources.string: Enter your birth date, time and city. I can help you open your chart.
Check your birth time and selected city. When they are right, calculate your chart.
Something needs correcting. Check the message in the form, update the details and try again.
Your chart is being calculated. You can wait a moment or keep using the menu.
The chart could not be calculated. Try again? Your entered details remain in the form.
Your chart is ready. Tap a planet for an explanation or open your personal forecast.
Your chart is calculated, but the changes are not saved yet. Save them?
Saving. Wait for confirmation so you know everything has been stored.
Your chart is saved! You can open its forecast now.
Saving did not finish. Your details are still on screen — try saving again.
Loading the forecast for your selected period. You can use another section meanwhile.
Your forecast is ready. Start with its meaning and advice; record your observations in the diary.
You are reading a saved forecast. Refresh it when you are connected again.
The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try loading the forecast again.
The forecast has not loaded. Retry the request or choose another chart.
A forecast needs a saved chart. Let us choose one from your list.
This section requires sign-in. Open Account and check your session.
This report is not currently accessible. You can return to your chart list.
Opening your diary. Wait while your entries load.
Record your mood, events and thoughts here. Save your entry when you finish.
Your entry is saved! Return to it by selecting this date in the diary.
Open Account
The chart operation could not be completed. Check your saved charts before trying again.
